outcome: need for maternal intensive care unit admission
cohort: 340 pregnant women who underwent elective (n=170) and emergency (n=170) caesarean section
finding: Maternal and fetal complications were significantly higher in the emergency caesarean section as compared to the elective caesarean section group.
mod_finding: Maternal and fetal complications were significantly higher in the emergency caesarean section as compared to the elective caesarean section group.
